meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会维护持久化的长期目标:可创建带 token 预算的目标、查询当前目标、核验证据后标记完成;暂停/恢复/清空等由 /goal 命令控制。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求设置、继续或审计长期目标,或已有进行中的目标时触发。

say.text: 创建一个长期目标:完成 pi-goal 扩展,token 预算 50000。
say.note: 调用 create_goal 创建持久目标。

say.text: 查看当前进行中的目标。
say.note: 调用 get_goal 返回当前目标。

say.text: 这个目标完成了,标记一下吧。
say.note: 会先按规则核验,再调用 update_goal。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude maintains persistent long-term goals: it can create goals with token budgets, query the current goal, verify evidence before marking complete; pause/resume/clear are controlled by /goal commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, or audit a long-running goal, or when an active goal already exists.

say_en.text: Create a long-running goal: finish the pi-goal extension with a token budget of 50000.
say_en.note: Calls create_goal to persist the goal.

say_en.text: Show me the current goal status.
This goal is done, mark it complete.
say_en.note: It audits first, then calls update_goal.
